_doc: US S1G profiles for the MM6108, keyed by intent (range <-> rate).

Channels sit at the top of 902-928 to stay clear of the bench's LoRa
activity lower in the band (mesh-v4 co-siting hazard #119).
phy_note figures are VENDOR numbers, not measurements - mesh-v4 rule:
never weight a rung on a datasheet number. Measure before comparing.
